description: Column and constraint definitions for the Tobin's Q Brand Equity firm-year panel scaffold.
tobins_q_theoretical_basis: Simon & Sullivan (1993) financial-market-based brand equity approach
formula_variant: Chung & Pruitt (1994) simplified Tobin's Q approximation
car_role_note: CAR is NOT a substitute for Tobin's Q. CAR is a short-window event-study market reaction proxy. Tobin's Q is the primary long-run level-based Brand Equity DV.

panel_csv.description: Firm-year panel with Tobin's Q computation status. One row per (company_name, fiscal_year).

columns.name: company_name
columns.description: Company name from korea_uni event study

columns.name: ticker
columns.description: Stock ticker symbol (upper-case)

columns.name: cik
columns.description: SEC Central Index Key (leading zeros stripped)

columns.name: filing_date
columns.description: 10-K filing date (YYYY-MM-DD) from korea_uni

columns.name: total_assets
columns.description: Total assets from financial statement panel (book value). Empty if not available.

columns.name: total_liabilities
columns.description: Total liabilities from financial statement panel (book value). Empty if not available.

columns.name: market_cap
columns.description: Market capitalization at fiscal year-end. Derived as stock_price_fiscal_year_end × shares_outstanding or sourced directly. Empty if not available.

columns.name: shares_outstanding
columns.description: Shares outstanding at fiscal year-end. Empty if not available.

columns.name: stock_price_fiscal_year_end
columns.description: Closing stock price at fiscal year-end date. Empty if not available.

columns.name: tobins_q
columns.description: Tobin's Q = (market_cap + total_liabilities) / total_assets. Empty if any component is missing.

columns.name: tobins_q_formula_used
columns.description: Formula string used to compute Tobin's Q. Empty if computation was not possible.

columns.name: data_available_flag
columns.description: true if Tobin's Q was computed for this row; false otherwise.

columns.name: missing_component_reason
columns.description: Semicolon-delimited list of financial components that are missing and prevented Tobin's Q computation.

missing_components_csv.description: Aggregate report of which financial components are missing and how to resolve them.

columns.name: component_name
columns.description: Name of the financial component (e.g., total_assets)

columns.name: required_for
columns.description: Role in Tobin's Q formula (numerator, denominator, intermediate)

columns.name: source_type
columns.description: Category of external data source needed

columns.name: rows_missing
columns.description: Number of panel rows where this component is missing

columns.name: status
columns.description: not_available_in_repo | available | partial

columns.name: resolution_path
columns.description: Recommended data source and join key to resolve this gap

manifest_json.description: Run manifest with counts, coverage stats, and constraint flags.

constraint_flags.description: These fields must ALL be false in every valid run.

flags.external_data_downloaded: No external data was downloaded during script execution
flags.sec_collection_run: No SEC EDGAR collection or API call was made
flags.market_data_collection_run: No market price data was collected or fetched
flags.tobins_q_imputed: No Tobin's Q value was estimated, imputed, or approximated from proxies
flags.car_used_as_tobins_q: CAR was not used as or substituted for Tobin's Q
flags.raw_data_modified: No raw/external data files were modified
flags.humor_outputs_modified: No humor analysis outputs were modified

financial_panel_source.note: Must be supplied via --financial-panel argument. Not included in repo.

market_cap.crsp_direct: prc × shrout (CRSP daily at FY-end date)

forbidden_operations: Imputing or estimating Tobin's Q when financial components are missing
Using CAR as a substitute for or equivalent to Tobin's Q
Using AbnormalVolume as a substitute for Tobin's Q
Treating CAR as direct consumer-based brand equity
Making causal claims from cross-sectional correlations
Downloading external financial data during script execution
Calling SEC EDGAR API or any external market data API
